en: Colorized vintage postcard showing a river scene with small boats moored at a quay in the foreground and a larger ferry or barge carrying people across the river in the middle distance. A simple wooden pier with white railings extends into the water on the left, while on the right a man stands near a moored vessel and several large cylindrical barrels or buoys. On the far bank there are trees, low buildings and a faint bridge structure. The card has a cream border and printed red caption at the bottom.
